name: engine-analysis
description: Runs the one analyze function that turns a change-set into an immutable result with groups, graph, and ordering.

name: engine-changes
description: Captures exact Git comparisons and frozen snapshots of both sides, stored outside the reviewed repository.

name: engine-entities
description: The only wrapper around sem-core; exposes entities, edges, changes, and coverage gaps.

name: review-flows
description: Finds entrypoints, groups changes into flows, labels fallback grouping, and decides reading order.

name: review-anchors
description: Gives code locations stable IDs and re-finds them in later snapshots as exact, moved, ambiguous, or missing.

name: review-evidence
description: Collects model-free facts and artifacts, and finds the tests, comments, imports, and callers next to each entity.

name: review-claims
description: Stores agent claims pinned to anchors, links them to evidence, records reviewer decisions, and handles pointing.

name: review-queue
description: Delivers reviewer feedback to agents and keeps their replies, questions, and resolution state.
